Figure 1:Overview ofAdviSD.(A) Multi-turn advising.Before each executor response, the advisor provides advice or abstains;
the frozen executor uses its native context and any issued advice.(B) Training from targeted feedback.Reflection proposes corrections at advice decisions in imperfect episodes.
Among flagged decisions,AdviSDretains original abstentions and those
whose scores with and without issued advice differ by more than a
calibrated threshold. The pre-update advisor computes both on the same
recorded executor response. At retained decisions, a feedback-conditioned
copy of the pre-update advisor teaches the trainable advisor, which sees
only the original context. This self-distillation supplements GRPO
on all episodes.
